# ScreenHeader

The top of every screen and sheet: an optional avatar and eyebrow, the serif title, an optional date and sentence, and up to two actions.

`NomNom.ScreenHeader` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.ScreenHeader title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.ScreenHeader" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The top of every screen and sheet: avatar, eyebrow, serif title, date, one sentence and up to two actions. Centred when there is an avatar or `role` is 'tabRoot' or 'moment'; otherwise start. No align, size, meta, facts or badges.

## Props (ScreenHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` | serif-lg, the screen's only h1. |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | ONE item: a category ("Italian") or the context it lives in ("The Friday Feast Club"). Never two joined, never a date, product or flow name, status, count, p… |
| `date` | `Date \| string` | A date only. A Date is formatted "Sunday 4 October" (year only when it isn't this year). |
| `summary` | `string` | One sentence, sans-md secondary, capped at container-sm. |
| `avatar` | `AvatarProps` | Always size 'xl'. Centres the header. |
| `role` | `'standard' \| 'tabRoot' \| 'moment'` | The kind of screen. 'standard' = detail screens and sheets (start); 'tabRoot' = Meals, Recipes, Parties (centred, with a summary); 'moment' = a full-screen f… |
| `actions` | `AppButtonProps[]` | Up to two AppButtons, md, label only (icon, fullWidth and size are ignored). At most one solid. One row. |
